definitions.gloss: for emergency use; emergency (used as a modifier)
definitions.explanation: Designating equipment, supplies, or facilities meant to be used in an emergency rather than in normal operation. Usually attaches to another noun with の or as a prefix-like element.

examples.japanese: {非常用|ひじょうよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食料|しょくりょう}→食料：03250_shokuryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{備|そな}える→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧。
examples.english: I keep emergency food supplies on hand.

examples.japanese: {非常用|ひじょうよう}⟦{階段|かいだん}→階段：00782_kaidan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{裏側|うらがわ}→裏側：03042_uragawa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The emergency stairs are on the back side of the building.

examples.japanese: ⟦{停電|ていでん}→停電：03544_teiden⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}えて→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧、{非常用|ひじょうよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{電源|でんげん}→電源：04429_dengen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}して→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧おく⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: We need to prepare an emergency power supply in case of a blackout.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{非常|ひじょう}→非常：01598_hijou⟧ (emergency) + ⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧ (for the use of). The {〜用|よう} suffix is highly productive: ⟦{業務用|ぎょうむよう}→業務用：13148_gyoumuyou⟧ (commercial-use), ⟦{家庭用|かていよう}→家庭用：16544_kateiyou⟧ (household-use), {子供用|こどもよう} (for children).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {非常用|ひじょうよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食料|しょくりょう}→食料：03250_shokuryou⟧: emergency food supplies
- {非常用|ひじょうよう}⟦{階段|かいだん}→階段：00782_kaidan⟧: emergency stairs
- {非常用|ひじょうよう}⟦{電源|でんげん}→電源：04429_dengen⟧: emergency power supply
- {非常用|ひじょうよう}{持|も}ち{出|だ}し{袋|ぶくろ}: emergency go-bag
- {非常用|ひじょうよう}{口|ぐち}: emergency exit

COMMON PATTERNS:
Normally modifies another noun directly ({非常用|ひじょうよう}⟦{電源|でんげん}→電源：04429_dengen⟧) or with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ ({非常用|ひじょうよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧). Does not function as a standalone predicate.
